description_ar: محادثات قصيرة (8-10 جمل، 45 ثانية - 1.5 دقيقة) بين طالب وموظف/أستاذ. سؤالان لكل محادثة: الفكرة الرئيسية والتفاصيل/الاستنتاج.

coach_notes_ar: 🎯 قبل الاستماع: اقرأ السؤال إن وُجد، وتوقّع موضوع المحادثة من السياق.
👥 حدّد دور كل متحدث: طالب؟ موظف مكتبة؟ أستاذ؟ مستشار أكاديمي؟
📝 دوّن بالرموز: ? = مشكلة، ! = حل، → = نتيجة، $ = مال/رسوم.
🔑 ركّز على: سبب المحادثة (لماذا جاء الطالب؟) والحل المقترح.
🎵 لاحظ النبرة: قلق، حماس، إحباط، ارتياح - تساعد في أسئلة الموقف.
⚠️ خطأ شائع: التركيز على التفاصيل ونسيان الفكرة العامة. ابدأ بالعام ثم الخاص.

conversations.transcript_en: Student: Excuse me, Professor Allen, do you have a minute? Professor: Sure, come in. What's on your mind? Student: I'm working on the research paper for your history class, and I'm having trouble finding sources on the topic I chose. Professor: Which topic did you pick? Student: The economic effects of the Silk Road. Professor: That's a broad area. Have you tried the university's online database? Student: I did, but most articles are too general. Professor: I see. I can lend you two books from my office that focus on trade routes. Would that help? Student: Yes, that would be great. Could I also have a few extra days? Professor: I can give you until next Friday, but no later. Student: Thank you so much, Professor.
conversations.transcript_ar: محادثة بين طالب وأستاذ التاريخ حول صعوبة إيجاد مصادر لبحث عن طريق الحرير، وطلب تمديد الموعد.

questions.question_en: Why does the student visit the professor?
options: To submit his completed paper
To ask for help with sources and request an extension
To drop the history class
To discuss his exam grade
questions.explanation_ar: الطالب يطلب مصادر ومدّة إضافية - هذا هو الغرض الرئيسي للزيارة.

questions.question_en: What does the professor offer the student?
options: A new topic and a tutor
Two books and an extension until Friday
Access to a private library
A meeting with another professor
questions.explanation_ar: الأستاذ قدّم كتابين وتمديد حتى الجمعة - مذكورتان صراحةً في الحوار.

conversations.transcript_en: Student: Hi, I'd like to report a problem with my dorm room. Staff: Of course. What's the issue? Student: The heater hasn't worked for three days, and it's getting really cold at night. Staff: I'm sorry to hear that. Did you submit an online maintenance request? Student: I did, two days ago, but nobody came. Staff: Let me check the system. Hmm, your request is marked as 'received' but not assigned yet. I'll mark it urgent now. Student: Thank you. Is there any way I could move to another room temporarily? Staff: We have one empty room on the second floor. You can stay there tonight if you want. Student: That would be perfect. How do I get the key? Staff: Come back at 4 PM and I'll have it ready.
conversations.transcript_ar: طالب يبلغ عن عطل في التدفئة ويطلب الانتقال المؤقت لغرفة أخرى.

questions.question_en: What is the main problem the student is reporting?
options: A broken window in his dorm
A heater that has not worked for three days
A noisy roommate
A lost room key
questions.explanation_ar: المشكلة الأساسية: المدفأة معطلة منذ ثلاثة أيام - ذُكرت في بداية الحوار.

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about the maintenance system?
options: It works very efficiently
Requests can be delayed or overlooked
It is only available online at night
Students cannot use it directly
questions.explanation_ar: الطلب قُدِّم قبل يومين ولم يُعالَج - يدل على وجود تأخير في النظام.

conversations.transcript_en: Advisor: So, Sara, you wanted to discuss your electives for next semester? Student: Yes, I'm torn between Introduction to Psychology and Modern Art History. Advisor: Both are popular. What's your major again? Student: Business administration. Advisor: Interesting. Psychology can really help in business - especially in marketing and human resources. Student: That's what my brother said too. But I've always loved art, and the schedule for that class fits better with my part-time job. Advisor: I understand. Have you considered taking psychology in the summer term? It's offered as an intensive course. Student: I didn't know that. How many weeks is it? Advisor: Six weeks, three hours a day. Student: That's intense, but I could manage it. So you're suggesting I take art history now and psychology in summer? Advisor: Exactly. That way you get both, and your schedule stays balanced.
conversations.transcript_ar: طالبة إدارة أعمال تستشير مرشدها بين مادة علم النفس وتاريخ الفن، فيقترح حلاً وسطاً.

questions.question_en: Why does the advisor suggest taking psychology in the summer?
options: Because it is cheaper in summer
To allow Sara to take art history now without conflict
Because the regular semester course is full
To help her graduate earlier
questions.explanation_ar: اقترح المرشد الصيف لأن جدول الفن مناسب أكثر للعمل الجزئي، فيمكنها أخذ الاثنين بدون تعارض.

questions.question_en: What is Sara's attitude toward the summer option?
options: She refuses immediately
She is uncertain and asks for more details
She thinks it is impossible
She finds it intense but feasible
questions.explanation_ar: قالت 'That's intense, but I could manage it' - تعترف بالصعوبة لكنها قابلة للتنفيذ.

conversations.transcript_en: Student: Hi, I'd like to borrow these four books, please. Librarian: Let me see your ID. Okay, you're a graduate student, so you can borrow up to ten books for thirty days. Student: Great. Actually, I also need a book that's not in the catalog. It's about ancient Egyptian agriculture. Librarian: If we don't have it, you can request it through Interlibrary Loan. Have you used that before? Student: No, how does it work? Librarian: You fill out an online form, we contact partner libraries, and the book is usually here within a week. Student: A week? My paper is due in five days. Librarian: In that case, try our digital archive first. Many specialized books are available as e-books. If you can't find it, I'd recommend visiting the main city library downtown - they have a strong history section. Student: That's a good idea. Is there a fee? Librarian: No, students enter for free with their university ID.
conversations.transcript_ar: طالب دراسات عليا يستعير كتباً ويسأل عن كتاب غير متوفر، فيُرشَد لخيارات بديلة.

questions.question_en: How long does Interlibrary Loan usually take?
options: About one day
About one week
About one month
It varies between two and five days
questions.explanation_ar: ذكرت الموظفة 'usually here within a week' - أي أسبوع تقريباً.

questions.question_en: Why does the librarian suggest the downtown library?
options: Because it has cheaper books
Because the student's deadline is too short for Interlibrary Loan
Because the university library is closing
Because the student is not allowed to use Interlibrary Loan
questions.explanation_ar: البحث يستحق خلال 5 أيام والإعارة بين المكتبات تأخذ أسبوعاً، لذا اقترحت بديلاً أسرع.

conversations.transcript_en: Student: Professor Reed, I wanted to talk about my midterm grade. Professor: Yes, I expected you might come. Your score was lower than your usual performance. Student: I know. Honestly, I studied for almost a week, but the questions felt completely different from the practice ones. Professor: That's a common complaint, but if you look carefully, the concepts were the same - only the applications changed. Student: That's exactly where I struggled. I memorized procedures but couldn't apply them to new contexts. Professor: That's an important realization. Chemistry isn't about memorization; it's about understanding patterns. Student: How do you recommend I prepare for the final? Professor: Solve problems from different textbooks, not just the assigned one. Also, form a small study group - explaining concepts to others forces deep understanding. Student: I'll do that. Is there any extra credit available? Professor: Not officially, but if you significantly improve on the final, I consider effort in my final grading.
conversations.transcript_ar: طالب يناقش درجته المنخفضة في النصفي ويسأل عن استراتيجيات للنهائي.

questions.question_en: What is the central message the professor conveys?
options: The student should drop the course
Memorization is not enough; understanding patterns matters
The exam was too difficult for most students
Chemistry exams will become easier
questions.explanation_ar: الأستاذ يؤكد: 'Chemistry isn't about memorization; it's about understanding patterns' - الفكرة المحورية.

questions.question_en: What is the professor's tone throughout the conversation?
options: Angry and dismissive
Supportive but honest
Indifferent and bored
Overly enthusiastic
questions.explanation_ar: الأستاذ صريح بشأن السبب لكنه يقدم نصائح عملية ويعترف بالجهد - نبرة داعمة وصادقة.

conversations.transcript_en: Student: Dr. Patel, thank you for meeting with me. I'm interested in applying for the summer research program in your lab. Professor: Glad to hear it. Have you taken Molecular Biology yet? Student: Yes, last semester. I got an A-. I've also been reading recent papers on CRISPR applications in plant genetics. Professor: Impressive. The program is competitive - we accept only three undergraduates each year. What specifically interests you? Student: I'd like to explore how gene editing can improve drought resistance in crops, especially given climate concerns. Professor: That aligns well with our current project. However, I should warn you - the work involves long hours, repetitive procedures, and patience with failed experiments. Student: I understand. I've worked in Dr. Kim's lab as a volunteer, so I'm familiar with that reality. Professor: Excellent. Submit your application and a one-page research proposal by April 15. I'll also need two recommendation letters. Student: Will do. Could I cite Dr. Kim as one of my references? Professor: Of course - she's a strong reference for hands-on lab experience.
conversations.transcript_ar: طالب جامعي يتقدم لبرنامج بحثي صيفي في علم الوراثة النباتية ويناقش متطلبات القبول.

questions.question_en: Why does the professor warn the student about long hours and failed experiments?
options: To discourage the student from applying
To set realistic expectations about lab research
To suggest the student work elsewhere
Because the student lacks experience
questions.explanation_ar: التحذير يهدف لضبط التوقعات - ليس لإحباطه، بل ليكون واعياً لطبيعة العمل البحثي.

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about the student's qualifications?
options: He is unqualified and unlikely to be accepted
He has both academic and practical preparation
He needs to retake Molecular Biology
He has no previous lab experience
questions.explanation_ar: حصل على A- في الأحياء الجزيئية + قرأ أبحاث CRISPR + تطوع في مختبر د. كيم - إعداد أكاديمي وعملي قوي.
